API reference

Swagger UI loads the OpenAPI specification. Privacy and limits and service terms apply. {{.PaymentDetails}}

First paid call

  1. Use an x402 v2 client with a dedicated spending wallet holding USDC on Base. A wallet address alone is not payment.
  2. Send your request to {{.Resource}}. The initial 402 response supplies the payment quote.
  3. Read the quote, limits and terms. Authorize the payment locally; the client resends the identical body with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Never send us your private key.
  4. Inspect the HTTP status and JSON result, including truncated, and retain the PAYMENT-RESPONSE receipt. Successful partial and blank results are chargeable.

Runnable TypeScript client and representative result (Markdown). The same guide is in the GitHub README. For response loss or uncertain settlement, follow the guide’s retry instructions before authorizing another payment.
